title: An asserted pass that also cites a note is refused as if no gate had been cited
outcome: An evaluator whose asserted or observed pass cites one admissible record and one inadmissible record is told which citation is the problem and that every citation must be of the admissible kind, so it can correct the submission in one step.
acceptance: the evaluate help text or the docs state the same rule
the refusal for a mixed citation list names the offending locator and says every citation of an asserted pass must be a passing gate record (and likewise for observed), asserted by a test

completion.summary: Landed in 0d6eb26: mixed citation refusals name the offending record and the every-citation rule for asserted and observed passes.
